title: Casper and the Autopsy
author: Quentin Iversen
blurb: August Voss, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
